result.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code § 13.76.130(A)(1) (Ord. No. 7,950-N.S., Berkeley Tenant Protection and Right to Organize Act, approved by voters Nov. 5, 2024)
result.citation_basis: § 13.76.130(A)(1): O096, O050; Ord. No. 7,950-N.S. and short title Berkeley Tenant Protection and Right to Organize Act: O050; Nov. 5, 2024 election date: O050, O052
result.official_quote: This subsection shall not constitute grounds where the amount of rent demanded is less than one month of fair market rent for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
result.note: Replaced the Measure BB nickname citation with the codified section the lawyer requested, narrowed to subsection (A)(1) where the nonpayment threshold sits, added the amending ordinance number 7,950-N.S. that O050 shows, and used the ordinance's own short title instead of 'Measure BB', which its text does not use.
